scenarioName: Profile Edit - Text Field Re-enter Validation
testName: Edit profile (Platform): text field should throw validation errors if the values in actual field and confirm field are not equal
objective: When 'Include Re-enter for validation' is set on this field, user enters different values in actual field and the confirm field while editing the profile, user should be able to see the validation error
precondition: Checkbox 'Include re-enter for validation' should be checked for the field
